g.text: GALINI / L03 / roofs and structural context
Architectural intent / later actual roof-on and cutaway captures must share the same source hash
Complete pitched roofs over every occupied
building. Labels show world-Z eaves; ridge
is 1.5 m higher. Lower/upper rooms are
below these roofs. Unlisted openings are
closed. No scenic roof is a route.
Bridge support: BR-M x50–78, y56–62, floor
+4; .60 m deck with two 2 m-wide masonry
piers at x58 and70. BR-U follows the bent
polygon x54–76, floor +8; .70 m deck and
piers at x61 and70. Both reach substantial
rock-bank abutments. Bed is scenic at -6.
Bridge parapets are outside the clear floor
Stone bridge photo study: continuous arch,
parapet and broad bank support informed the
structural mass. Flat decks and pier
adaptations, not measured dimensions or an
